assessments.name: Museum reports
assessments.description: Submission of completed electronic online workbooks at the end of each module including images captured/up-loaded during the allocated microscope practical class and museum session for each student will accumulate 10% of the final course mark.

assessments.description: Pathology is an image-rich discipline focused on diseased. This test will inform students on how questions in pathology are constructed from images taken at microscopic and macroscopic levels using diseased organs from module 1 - no marks are recorded
